reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Removed the `statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name` label from pods and external listeners Kubernetes Services", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: workload-failure

consequence.statement: A custom setup that leverages the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label stops working after the upgrade because the label is no longer applied to pods and external listener Kubernetes Services.
consequence.remediation: Replace any use of the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label with the strimzi.io/pod-name label.

proposed.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removed the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label from pods and external listeners Kubernetes Services, and any custom setup leveraging that label must use the strimzi.io/pod-name label instead.
